title: Tamil Nadu Politics – Morning Brief – 31 October 2026
headline: Seeman hints at accepting the support of DMK and AIADMK in Ambasamudram byelection

sections.big_picture:
- **AIADMK, DMK — Seeman hints at accepting the support of DMK and AIADMK in Ambasamudram byelection:** At an interaction with journalists at Pasumpon after paying tributes to Muthuramalinga Thevar, he wondered why he should not accept their support when he had been yearning for an election victory for long.
- **TVK — Stalin demands apology from T.N. CM Vijay for MIDS professor’s detention; TVK denies ‘political vendetta’ claim:** The ruling TVK said the inquiry was not related to the professor’s remarks on rising rice prices.
- **State Update — MIDS professor Kalaiyarasan’s colleagues condemn police harassment:** Colleagues and academics condemn Tamil Nadu police harassment of MIDS professor Kalaiyarasan, urging accountability and safeguarding academic freedom.
- **State Update — Plea in Madras High Court seeks probe into nationality of Cockroach Janata Party co-convenor Saurav Das:** Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Justice G.
- **Ranipet — Man held for possession of 22 country-made explosives in Ranipet:** A tribal man from Irular community in Ranipet was arrested for possessing 22 country-made explosives, later jailed in Vellore Central Prison.
